_about: What a co-parenting app costs, from its own pricing page, with the date it was read. Plain facts only: no review quotes, no reviewer names, nominative names. Rendered on /alternatives/<slug>. Re-read when alternatives.json is re-measured.

en: Its pricing page says "You need a paid subscription to use the TalkingParents app", with a 30-day free trial.
It lists three plans: Essentials at $7, Enhanced at $16 and Ultimate at $32 a month, with a lower price if paid yearly.
It says parents facing financial hardship and survivors of domestic violence may qualify for a fee waiver.
es: Su página de precios dice "You need a paid subscription to use the TalkingParents app" (se necesita una suscripción de pago), con una prueba gratis de 30 días.
Muestra tres planes: Essentials a $7, Enhanced a $16 y Ultimate a $32 al mes, con un precio menor si se paga al año.
Dice que los padres con dificultades económicas y los sobrevivientes de violencia doméstica pueden recibir una exención de pago.

en: Its pricing page lists four plans billed yearly: $110, Essentials at $149.99, Premium at $216 and Max at $299.88, with lower prices for two years.
It says each parent needs their own subscription, and that one parent may pay for the other.
It says it offers fee waivers to parents in financial need.
es: Su página de precios muestra cuatro planes anuales: $110, Essentials a $149.99, Premium a $216 y Max a $299.88, con precios menores por dos años.
Dice que cada padre necesita su propia suscripción y que un padre puede pagar la del otro.
Dice que ofrece exenciones de pago a padres con necesidad económica.
